            malu <= 32'b0;
            mb <= 32'b0;

            mwreg <= 1'b0;
            mm2reg <= 1'b0;
            mwmem <= 1'b0;
            mrmem <= 1'b0;

            malu <= ealu;
            mb <= eb;
            pcm <= pce;
            mrn <= ern;
            mwreg <= ewreg;
            mm2reg <= em2reg;
            mwmem <= ewmem;
            mrmem <= ermem;
            mrio <= erio;
            mwio <= ewio;
        end
    end

endmodule
